solutions.title: Two pointers on sorted array
solutions.notes: Move left/right based on sum vs target
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Because the array is sorted, start at both ends and move the pointer that fixes an undershoot or overshoot.

**Example walkthrough:** Left `2`, right `15` sum too big → move right. Eventually `2+7=9` → return 1-based `[1, 2]`.
